garments.name: Fitted technical long-sleeve top
garments.description: A fitted black long-sleeve technical top cut to the hip in breathable performance knit. Crimson seam accents follow the shoulders and sides, while a small cyan circuit mark sits on the left chest. The silhouette is clean and mobile, with reinforced seams and subtle stretch panels.

garments.name: Oversized late-night lounge T-shirt
garments.description: An oversized black late-night T-shirt in soft brushed cotton-modal knit, falling to the upper thigh with short sleeves and relaxed dropped shoulders. A dark-violet and cyan circuit-fox graphic sits across the upper back, while the front stays mostly clean.

garments.name: Fitted circuit T-shirt
garments.description: A fitted black short-sleeve T-shirt with a small cyan circuit mark at the left chest, soft performance-cotton fabric, and clean stretch seams.

garments.name: Relaxed violet-trim T-shirt
garments.description: A relaxed black cotton-modal T-shirt with soft-violet neckline and sleeve trim, designed as an easy everyday casual top.

garments.name: Cropped technical T-shirt
garments.description: A fitted cropped black technical T-shirt with cyan seam accents, short sleeves, and lightweight stretch panels for warm conditions.

garments.name: Private sheer-panel crop top
garments.material: opaque stretch knit with sheer mesh side panels
garments.description: A private fitted black crop top with opaque bust coverage, dark-violet sheer side panels, a low back, and short sleeves. The cut is deliberately provocative while keeping the nipples covered.

garments.name: Fitted violet technical tank
garments.description: A fitted dark-violet technical tank with cyan edging, a clean racerback cut, and breathable fabric for warm-weather wear.

garments.name: Fitted technical tank
garments.description: A fitted black sleeveless technical tank in breathable performance knit with cyan panel accents, stretch zones, and reinforced seams for warm lab or workshop use.

garments.name: Private strappy halter top
garments.material: soft opaque stretch knit with decorative straps
garments.description: A private dark-violet halter-style top with opaque bust coverage, cyan decorative straps, and an open back. The silhouette is intentionally provocative while remaining covered.

garments.name: Performance training tank
garments.description: A fitted black performance tank with cyan panel seams and breathable mesh zones for exercise and high-mobility activity.

garments.name: Soft casual long-sleeve tee
garments.description: A relaxed black long-sleeve tee in soft cotton-modal knit with dark-violet cuff edging and an easy everyday fit.

garments.name: Fitted ribbed mock-neck top
garments.description: A fitted dark-violet ribbed long-sleeve top with a low mock neck and clean black edging, suitable for smart-casual settings.

garments.name: Thermal technical long-sleeve top
garments.description: A fitted black thermal long-sleeve top with a brushed interior, crimson seam accents, and comfortable insulation for cold conditions.

garments.name: Technical utility button-up
garments.description: A tailored black technical button-up with crimson panel seams, roll-tab sleeves, a low-profile hidden pocket, and enough stretch for workshop movement.

garments.name: Soft violet casual button-up
garments.description: A relaxed dark-violet button-up with a soft collar, black buttons, and a fluid woven knit that works for casual or smart-casual wear.

garments.name: Light technical hoodie

garments.name: Oversized violet lounge hoodie
garments.description: An oversized dark-violet lounge hoodie in soft brushed fleece with a large ear-aware hood, soft-violet trim, and a roomy front pocket.

garments.name: Fitted technical knit sweater
garments.description: A fitted black technical-knit sweater with subtle circuit-rib texture, cyan micro-accents, and clean ribbed cuffs.

garments.name: Private open-bust cropped top
garments.description: A private fitted black cropped top with short sleeves, dark-violet trim, and an open-bust construction that intentionally leaves the nipples exposed.
